items.title: Space Mobs
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Sound the alarm, the Space Mobs are invading earth! Will you join them? Play as one of the Space Mobs, each with a unique, far out design! Explore foreign lands and find a place to make your home!
- 10 skins
- Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Defense Labs
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Mobs are among us! Defend your survival base with a ton of new awesome turrets, traps, and improve your experience with new tools too! These new turrets are craftable and upgradeable! Survive in style with modern technology in a cool scientific base.

+ 10 turrets
+ 3 levels of turrets
+ 5 traps
+ 5 tools
+ 2 free skins!

items.title: Fruit Style
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Delicious skins! different fruits are waiting for you! Show to everyone that the fruit style is the best

-Perfect for picnics
-Enjoy with your friends
-Fruit Trending
-10 skins
-1 free skin

items.title: Trendy Summer Teens
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description: The summer is here and the outfits are on fire! Follow the trend among these 12 fashionable skins and rock all the styles. Get ready to have the best summer!

items.title: Penguins
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay as an adorable penguin!

+ 10 skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Trendy Friends
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
New parkour styles with Trendy Friends!

- 1 free skin!

items.title: Legends Of PVP
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
Equip your sword and armor! These legends will lead you to victory. Start having fun with unique characters.

Includes:
+ 12 skins to select.
+ 2 totally free skins.

Created by xfaddy and Published by Kuboc Studios.

items.title: Mask Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
You don't like to show yourself to other people, are you shy or it just fits the occasion. Then chooses a mask and feel free now. You can be who you want.

+ 10 different skins
+ Mask
+ Teens
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Ninja Axolotls
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Ninja axolotls are at their dojo protecting themselves from the outside darkness. No mob can stand a chance with these fierce colorful ninjas! Fight countless numbers of mobs in survival and even find yourself at the end, with the ender dragon! Which skin will you choose, to defeat the dragon?

-9 skins!
-Perfect for PVP battles!
-By: Hourglass Studio

items.title: Dragon Arena
items.creator: HorizonBlocks
items.description:
The Colossus Dragon and his army are trying to invade the arena. Each of them will challenge you differently, so equip yourself with unique weapons, armor, and potions to defeat the dragons!

+ 8 DIFFERENT DRAGONS
+ 5 FIGHTERS 
+ CUSTOM 3D WEAPONS AND ARMOR
+ FURNITURE ROOM
+ UNIQUE MUSIC AND VOICEOVER
+ NEW CUSTOM BOSS FIGHT

items.title: Perfect Purple
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Show your appreciation for the color purple with this pack! Decked out in cute outfits and fashionable designs, these 6 teen skins are making a statement. Have fun and play with your friends!

items.title: Red Boss
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Dress sharply while showing your love for the color red! Featuring 6 teen skins, each with trendy outfits and styles. Pick your favorite and have fun!

items.title: TOP 10
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Looking for a fresh style? These skins will blow you away! Here is the first release of Top 10 for Minecraft! For all gamers.

10 HD (128px) skins including:


- 9 trending outfits
- 1 exclusive free skin by: Dannny0117

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: Ore Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Shine like a diamond, glitter like gold! Delve deep into the mines and caverns with these stylish skins! Express your love for gems and metals like diamond, emerald, copper, and more!

- 12 skins for roleplay included
- Fun and modern teen skins
- Licensed by Xenon Design and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Cartoon Mobs
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
In today's edition, cartoon mobs! Play as one of 18 cartoon-style mob skins and become part of a cartoon-style adventure!

- 18 cartoon mob skins
+ Licensed by Levelatics and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Red Style
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
These teens chose their favorite color! It's your turn now. You have 12 awesome red outfits to try out and impress your friends with. Don't miss the opportunity!

- 12 red stylish outfits
- 1 free skin
- Licensed by Dragon Blocks and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Tie Dye
items.creator: Impulse
items.description: Tie-dying is a fun and rewarding pastime, and now you can enjoy that in Minecraft! Wear these colorful and unique tie-dyed outfits and look cute with your friends!

items.title: Safari Explorers
items.creator: Pixelbiester
items.description:
Explore this huge safari world with 24 African species living in handmade natural habitats. Extract DNA from animals to research it. Learn everything about the unlocked species. Find special materials and make technical inventions. Create your own electricity to use the machines and craft any kind of vehicle.

+ New crafting recipes 
+ Usable furniture
+ Special soundtrack
items.changelog: - Updated the porcupine's book to the library

items.title: Dinosaur Time
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Ever wondered what it’d be like to stand next to a Dinosaur? Well now you can become one! Go back in time with this skin pack and become the most fearsome of them all!

items.title: Robot O
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Life sure is easy as a robot! No problem is too hard to solve! Become a shiny metal robotic being today!

items.title: Craftables
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Craft a dog, cat, car, airplane, boat, dragon, skyscraper, TNT, furniture, and more! Each new item has its own mechanics and abilities. Build a city, decorate it with furniture, then bring it to life with animals, vehicles, and dragons.
- 19 crafting recipes total
- 8 themed stores
- 5 skins included

Play in this world to learn more about our other craftable maps!

items.title: Enderman Skyblock
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Giant Endermen have stolen chunks of the Overworld. Jungles, deserts, villages, and other biomes have been brought to The End. Survive with limited resources in this unique twist on skyblock. Each island has secrets to uncover.
- 19 giant Endermen
- 17 different biomes
- 5 skins
- Custom village spawn

Play skyblock in The End dimension!

items.title: Mob Costume
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Have you ever thought about having fun with your friends at a slumber party? Even more with animal and monster costumes? Come get them and have fun!

- 10 costumes skins!
- All pretty and cute!
- Perfect for a slumber party!

items.title: God Weapons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
God weapons are the most powerful weapons in Minecraft! Check out all the different weapons with this amazing mansion. 

- Tons of god weapons
- Great with friends!
